text: Glanlua is a minor Irish heroine. She appears in a tale of the Fianna. She helped Fionn Mac Cumhaill flee from a giant named Dryantore. Glanlua became the companion of Ailna. From her she learned of a magic drinking horn that restored health and strength. The wily Conan slipped the vessel to Fionn. Restored, Fionn broke his bonds and escaped.
